# TASK-011 Spec Context

- Context-SHA256: `61db4762c87b751740ac876f3acd4b5d5655ab9af4b34d551c3fcb54f2991643`

## Required Rules
- `frontend-component-specs#RULE-frontend-component-001`: Components must type props, keep presentational pieces free of network I/O, use stable list keys, and prefer Semi Design + CSS Modules over ad-hoc inline styles for layout/theme.
  - rule_sha256=e79c828738826162955fd6db0e99331d699d286fcf701c839b351b0c833ed119 verifier=frontend-component-specs#RULE-frontend-component-001; artifacts=skill-execution-control-and-review.frontend.design.md,skill-execution-control-and-review.md
- `frontend-quality-standards#RULE-frontend-quality-001`: Console frontend changes must keep TypeScript strict typing, explicit async loading/error/success handling, and pass project frontend validators (tsc/eslint/prettier/vitest when applicable).
  - rule_sha256=d02c28f2c041bfa9eea4ffc592e5352a37e8884776ec581eea954e1f49b6a4c0 verifier=frontend-quality-standards#RULE-frontend-quality-001; artifacts=skill-execution-control-and-review.frontend.design.md,skill-execution-control-and-review.md
- `frontend-quality-standards#RULE-frontend-i18n-001`: 用户可见文案一律走 i18n：组件内 `useTranslation()`（依赖 `t` 的配置数组用 `useMemo(..., [t])`），组件外纯模块（`api.ts` / `channels.ts` / `model.ts` / `createPodModel.ts` / `Pagination`）直接 `import i18n` 用 `i18n.t`；新增 key 必须同步补 `locales/zh.ts` 与 `locales/en.ts`。
  - rule_sha256=f7949e0627700b461018be02191edc4b983370e1968d47b5c5f0376b04c4e019 verifier=frontend-quality-standards#RULE-frontend-i18n-001; artifacts=skill-execution-control-and-review.frontend.design.md,skill-execution-control-and-review.md
